svg.title: Correlated Gaussian contours
svg.desc: What this figure shows: Off-diagonal covariance rotates elliptical equal-density contours, encoding statistical dependence. The plotted object is generated from p(x) proportional to exp[-1/2 (x-mu)^T Sigma^-1 (x-mu)]. How to read it: compare the labeled axes, curves, contours, matrix entries, bars, or markers exactly as defined in the atlas entry; the visible trend is the numerical realization of the stated equation or construction. Scientific status: Equation-driven probability geometry. Unless explicitly identified otherwise, this is not empirical consciousness data.
